data.name: The Rise Of The Slime King
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

The Slime Kingdom has spent generations being pushed around by every other kingdom in the realm. Those days are over.

Rise as the Slime King, unite your army, capture enemy territory, and lead your kingdom to victory in a fantasy roguelite auto-battler where every battle tells a different story.

Every level grants powerful upgrades, but your enemies won't stand still. As your army grows stronger, rival kingdoms adapt with new mutations, forcing you to rethink your strategy every run.

Lead the Slime Kingdom

Command an ever-growing army of slimes as you push across the battlefield, capture villages, and unlock new allies to strengthen your forces.

Grow from a lone slime into the legendary Slime King capable of leading an unstoppable kingdom.

Every Run Is Different

No two battles are the same.

Choose from randomized upgrade cards each level to create powerful combinations while enemy kingdoms evolve in response to your choices.

Experiment with different builds and discover new strategies every game.

Capture and Conquer

Fight across contested territory where villages can change hands throughout the battle.

Capturing locations grants powerful advantages, unlocks additional slime reinforcements, and helps your kingdom push toward the enemy castle.

Face Growing Threats

Enemy armies become stronger as the battle continues.

Battle powerful fantasy creatures, survive increasingly difficult waves, and defeat dangerous bosses standing between your kingdom and victory.

Features

• Fantasy roguelite auto-battler gameplay

• Tug-of-war lane combat

• Capture villages to strengthen your kingdom

• Build unique character combinations with randomized upgrade cards

• Enemy mutation system that adapts to your decisions

• Multiple slime types to command

• Boss battles

• Character progression throughout every run

• Endless replayability through randomized upgrades

The Slime Kingdom has been underestimated for far too long.

Now it's time to prove that even the smallest heroes can conquer an entire world.

data.short_description: Lead the Slime Kingdom in a fantasy roguelite auto-battler that blends hero combat with tug-of-war strategy. Control powerful Slime Champions, unlock new slime soldiers, capture villages, choose game-changing upgrades, and conquer rival kingdoms in dynamic lane-based battles.
